result: SAM's curvature regularization is dynamical: unnormalized SAM is stable only while η(λ_max + ρλ_max²) < 2, an edge below GD's 2/η, and during training the top eigenvalue settles on this SAM edge, far from any minimum.
result_plain: SAM has its own edge of stability η(λ + ρλ²) = 2 and pins the top eigenvalue there during training.
